objective: Measure requested allocation traffic and retained bytes for the row-preserving normal-form filter against its deterministic-selection parent.
measurement: Six phases: construction, cold hull, warm hull, replay hull, drop retained outputs and original input, clear grammar cache. Record requested global allocator calls/bytes, retained live-byte deltas and peaks above phase entry. Instrumented times are diagnostic only.
output_contract: All full original vertex orders, triangle rows, certainty, byte sizes and checksums must match the exact-validated parent across both groups and all three phases. All output meshes stay alive until after replay, with no intervening validation or serialization.
prerequisites: Frozen twelve-command broader normal-image qualification completed.
Frozen fifty-eight-command normal-image native cost trial completed with identical outputs and no predeclared reproducible-cost-increase flag.
limits: Requested bytes are not usable allocator sizes, stack usage or RSS.
Process-global scalar caches may survive input disposal and grammar-cache clearing; lifecycle retention is reported without inferring its owner.
No uninstrumented timing or universal memory bound is claimed.
Broader formal and directed adversarial obligations remain.
